title: Promoted Context Next Answer QA
principle: Promoted memory and Saved chats knowledge must improve the next answer only when relevant and with visible review.
public_repo_rule: QA evidence is synthetic metadata only. It contains no real prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

scenarios.expected: Promoted local memory is selected when the next prompt matches it and writes memory-use review state.
Saved chats knowledge from an enabled collection is included in the next relevant local chat context.
Disabled knowledge collections are skipped even when their text matches the next prompt.
Next chat context orders system, role/runtime, memory, backend memory, local knowledge and backend knowledge before the user prompt.
scenarios.visible_review: Memory panel Used in last message
